quest.title: A Little Booze Doesn't Hurt...
quest.description: Nimrod wants to enjoy a few drinks from the tavern, but he needs some help to deal with his wife...

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Boy do I need a drink...

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: But if Eury catches me drinking, it'll be the end of me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is everything okay?

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh... It's fine, I just fancy a little drink is all.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: My wife Eury can't stand it when I drink, though, so I never touch the stuff at home.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: All I can do is wait till she's gone out shopping and then slip out for a few quick ones.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The first step is admitting you have a problem...

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Hey! Don't be like that. I'm hardly the only person in Mondstadt who's fond of a drink.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: But could you go and distract Eury for a while? Just long enough for one or two brews, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Whenever Eury goes shopping, all it takes is a little too much choice and she'll be there all day trying to make up her mind!

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: She's guaranteed to keep thinking it over as long as you can keep making sure there's another option...

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Haha, excellent! May your glasses forever flow with the fine wine of good fortune, my friends!

choices.text: How long do you plan on drinking for, exactly?

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Ho-ho, well that depends how long you can...

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: ...N—No, I just need enough time to enjoy one nice drink without having to down it...

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Just the one, I swear! You can always trust a tavern-goer in Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: Hmm... Sunsettias or apples? Decisions, decisions...

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wish Nimrod were here, I'd just pick what he wants...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Apologies, Eury ma'am. We're all out of sunsettias.

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: Oh, I see. Well, I guess it will have to be apples, then.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Ooh... Sorry Eury, I think these apples are starting to turn...

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: Really? Hmm... but there's no other choice.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Allow us!

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Huh? Allow you to...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: To help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Relax. We'll find some fresh <color=#00E1FFFF>sunsettias</color> for you.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: ...You will? Um, well thanks...!

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: This is great, Nimrod much prefers sunsettias to apples. I'll wait here then.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: It's so kind of you to get me some sunsettias, Beatrice bought the last ones just before I got here.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Did you find any sunsettias?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will these do?

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Gosh, that's plenty! This is amazing, thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: They look really good!

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: ...But these apples are so cheap. Maybe I should get some of each?

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Y—You're back? What's the... situation with Eury?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Judging by the smell, I'd say he's had more than one...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Eury is struggling with a big decision as we speak.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Great... great! I, uh... I guess I have time for another then! Bartender—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oi! You said just the one! You said you swear!

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Hehe... I did, didn't I? Just the one... I swear— I swear this next one is just the one for me! Haha! Bartender...

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Thank you, my friends. Please, take these. My gift to you.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Now, I must get back to my wine! Wine o'clock doesn't come every day...

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: I really am grateful to you... You know what? My husband recently quit drinking for my sake, and he's been so miserable since...

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: Maybe some of his favorite fruit will cheer him up a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: That said... The apples are better value for money...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's go get those sunsettias pronto!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We need to keep Eury umm-ing and ahh-ing for as long as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it just me or it is weird that Nimrod understands his wife so well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That should keep Eury pondering for a good while...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go and update Nimrod.
